question: Does the exact block8H1-written residual subspace identify its downstream attention readers directly from weight contractions, before observing held-out head patches?

searched: subspace weight atlas OV reader writer
prior_art_search.relation: Causal reader heads and activation axes have been measured, but no fit-sealed residual subspace has been translated into exact weights and prospectively checked against a held-out all-head causal atlas.

frozen_design.subspace_fit: Use only stratified A1-fit rows. Capture the exact block8H1 cue-write delta at all declared subject-onset positions at residual boundary 9; orient reciprocal directions geometrically and take the smallest SVD rank explaining at least 95% fit energy.
frozen_design.weight_predictions: Before opening head effects on evaluation rows, compute every layer9-17 head's Q/K/Q2/K2/V read contractions with the frozen residual basis, plus output/OV contractions. Rank value-read and routing-read scores separately.
frozen_design.causal_evaluation: On A1-heldout and all A2 rows, patch each of all 81 downstream heads from the exact writer run into base, one head per real forward. Compare sealed weight ranks with absolute rowwise causal response.
frozen_design.writer_check: Rank all block8 heads by target-subspace output capacity U^T O_h; H1 is evaluated as a positive-control writer, not counted as independent discovery.
frozen_design.fit: SVD rank selection on A1-fit activation energy only; no causal outcomes, gradients, or model updates enter the subspace or weight rankings

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_capture_and_: all hashes/capability/capture checks pass and A1 fit/heldout each contain eight rows per direction
predictions.pred_b_writer_positive_control: block8H1 ranks in the top three heads by normalized output capacity into the fitted subspace
predictions.pred_c_known_readers_are_weight_enriched: the five known reader heads have median value-read percentile >=0.70 among 81 heads
predictions.pred_d_value_beats_routing_for_causal_pr: value-read Spearman with absolute causal response is positive on both A1-heldout and A2 and exceeds the routing-read correlation on their mean
predictions.pred_e_top_weight_readers_are_causal: at least two of the top-six value-read heads have absolute writer-effect fraction >=0.05 on both A1-heldout and A2
predictions.pred_f_price_coverage_and_zero_causal_le: all 81 heads and both sealed evaluation splits are reported within price; no evaluation causal effect is used during fit/ranking

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, capability, capture, split, leakage, coverage, or price fails
terminal_rules.screen: all predictions pass: exact weights provide a useful reader-discovery map for this causal subspace
terminal_rules.null: valid run shows that raw weight contractions require contextualization; retain the exact atlas and add live-state Jacobian/gating factors rather than changing the subspace post hoc

interpretation_limits: The subspace is learned from one task's causal writer response, not from labels or held-out reader effects.
Raw weight incidence measures capacity; causal validation is required because RMS normalization, attention routing, and background state gate that capacity.
Cross-task sharing is not claimed until a second independently fitted causal subspace is compared through the same gauge-invariant weight objects.
